title: Suggestion : use NTP server for time check in objectives
symptom: AAPS uses date and time of the 4G connection to verify the real time during objectives, which may fail for phones without 4G accounts. Some users had problems with objectives when 4G was turned off.
fix: AAPS uses NTP server (time.google.com) for time check, and it only requires good connectivity to the server, regardless of whether it is WiFi or 3G/4G/5G.
